## Summary

Describe the editorial behavior or documentation change.

## Context and evidence

Explain the text type, audience, channel, register, locale, or source-language evidence that supports the change.

## Validation

- [ ] I checked the relevant reference files and examples.
- [ ] I added or updated a benchmark case when behavior changed.
- [ ] I checked meaning, terminology, register, and protected tokens.
- [ ] I checked relative links and Markdown fences.
- [ ] I ran the Skill validator when available.
- [ ] I removed private, copyrighted, and generated temporary content.

## Notes for reviewers

List any plausible alternative judgment or remaining uncertainty.
